福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

水仙宮Shuixian Temple

認識五位水仙尊王、三郊商人，還有市場裡的柴梳餅和九豬十六羊。

Meet the five water gods, the Three Guilds, and the pastries of the market.

歡迎來到五條港！第一站是水仙宮。你得穿過熱鬧的菜市場，才找得到它。很久以前，五條港道把船從台江內海帶進府城。水仙宮在 1715 年建在其中一條港道旁。這裡供奉五位水神：一帝、二王、二大夫。大禹治水，寒奡發明了船。項羽、屈原和伍子胥都不是「贏家」，但他們忠義。民間信仰看重的是忠義，不是成敗。水仙宮是三郊的總部，他們是府城最有錢的商人，出錢修廟、鋪路。在市場裡吃一塊像木梳的柴梳餅，再找找九豬十六羊糕仔，那是一組明朝的密碼。

Welcome to the Five Channels! Our first stop is Shuixian Temple. You have to walk through a busy market to find it. Long ago, five channels carried ships from the Taijiang Inner Sea into the city. The temple was built in 1715, beside one of them. It honors five water gods: an emperor, two kings, and two ministers. Dayu tamed the floods, and Han Ao invented boats. Xiang Yu, Qu Yuan and Wu Zixu were not winners, but they were loyal. Folk religion honors loyalty, not success. The temple was the headquarters of the Three Guilds, the richest merchants in town. They repaired temples and paved roads. In the market, try the chai-so pastry, shaped like a wooden comb. And look for nine pigs and sixteen goats, a secret code from the Ming.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 認識水仙宮水仙宮建於 1715 年（康熙五十四年），在昔日的港道旁，後來成為富有的三郊議事的所在。Shuixian Temple was built in 1715 beside an old harbor channel. Later, it became the meeting place of the rich merchant guilds.
  2. 五位水仙尊王一帝、二王、二大夫，生平都和水有關。An emperor, two kings, and two ministers, each tied to water.
  3. 三郊：商人就是市政府府城曾有二十多個「郊」，勢力最大的三個結成「三郊」，總部就在水仙宮的三益堂。The three strongest guilds joined together, and this temple was their headquarters.
  4. 寶來香與九豬十六羊市場裡的寶來香餅舖，約昭和十年開業；九豬十六羊糕仔是一組近三百年的密碼。Bao Lai Xiang Pastry Shop sells Tainan pastries, and one of them hides a secret code.
  5. 祈求吉慶四件套三川殿石堵上，武將與隨從拿著四樣東西，諧音「祈求吉慶」。Four objects on the stone panels spell a wish for good fortune.

認識景點

About the place

認識水仙宮About the temple

水仙宮：供奉水仙尊王，是五條港的代表廟宇。建廟年代多數記載為 1715 年（康熙五十四年），另有 1683、1703 年的說法。 商人集資：不是官府出錢，而是由商人集資興建；後來成為三郊議事的所在。 二戰轟炸：二戰時遭美軍轟炸，只剩原規模的五分之一。 藏在市場裡：廟名變成了菜市場的名字；要穿過攤位才找得到廟門。

Shuixian Temple: It honors the Water Immortal Kings. Most records say it was built in 1715. Other records say 1683 or 1703. Paid for by merchants: Merchants paid for it, not the government. Later, the merchant guilds met here. World War II bombing: Bombing in World War II left only one fifth of the temple. Hidden in a market: You have to walk through the market to find the temple.

五位水仙尊王The five Water Immortals

大禹：疏濬江河，平治洪水。 寒奡：發明舟船。 項羽：兵敗之後，死在江邊。 屈原：投汨羅江，以死勸諫君王。

Dayu: He tamed the great floods by dredging the rivers. Han Ao: He invented boats. Xiang Yu: After his defeat, he died by the river. Qu Yuan: He drowned himself in the Miluo River to admonish his king.

伍子胥：忠言不被接受，被賜死後拋屍錢塘江。 不以成敗論英雄：打敗仗的將軍、被賜死的忠臣，只要正直忠義，千百年來依然受人敬拜。

Wu Zixu: His king refused his advice and threw him into the Qiantang River. Loyalty, not success: Folk religion doesn't judge heroes by success or failure, only by loyalty.

三郊：商人就是市政府The Three Guilds

北郊 蘇萬利：1760 年代由知府蔣允焄促成，第一個任務是替淤積的港口清淤。 南郊 金永順：三郊之一。 糖郊 李勝興：三郊之一，糖是當時台灣的招牌出口貨。 海盜蔡牽：1800 年前後海盜橫行，三郊為了聯防結成同盟。

North Guild: It was formed in the 1760s to dredge the silting harbor. South Guild: One of the Three Guilds. Sugar Guild: Sugar was one of Taiwan's star exports. The pirate Cai Qian: Around 1800, the guilds joined together to defend against pirates.

出錢做公共建設：每艘出港船抽一筆錢，用來修廟、辦祭典、築城牆、造橋鋪路。

Public works: A fee on every ship paid for temples, festivals, city walls, roads and bridges.

寶來香與九豬十六羊Pastries with a secret

柴梳餅：形狀像老式木梳，外酥內軟，蒜香鹹甜。 綠豆椪：台南常見的傳統糕餅。 九豬：台語「九」音近「救」，「豬」暗指明朝國姓「朱」：救朱。 十六羊：代表明朝十六位皇帝；尖嘴是羊、寬嘴是豬，背上都點一抹紅。

chai-so pastry: It is shaped like an old-fashioned wooden comb. mung bean puff: A classic Tainan pastry. nine pigs: Nine pigs means save the Zhu, the Ming emperors' family. sixteen goats: Sixteen goats stand for the sixteen Ming emperors.

太陽公生：農曆三月十九，也是崇禎皇帝殉國的日子；2013 年登錄為市定民俗。

the Sun God's birthday: It falls on the day the last Ming emperor died.

祈求吉慶四件套Four lucky objects

旗 → 祈：旗(qí)＝祈，祈禱。 球 → 求：球(qiú)＝求，請求。 戟 → 吉：戟(jǐ)＝吉，吉祥。 磬 → 慶：磬(qìng)＝慶，喜慶。

flag: Flag sounds like to pray. ball: Ball sounds like to seek. halberd: Halberd sounds like lucky. chime: Chime sounds like celebration.

實景照片

Photos on site

柴梳餅 Chai-so pastries

前排對折成半月形的酥餅，就是柴梳餅：圓形餅皮對折後烘烤，形狀像老式木梳，內餡有濃濃的蒜香。

The folded half-moon pastries in front are chai-so pastries. A round crust is folded in half and baked, so it looks like an old wooden comb.

傳統糕餅 Traditional pastries

櫃台上擺滿臺南的傳統糕點：裹芝麻的點心、一袋袋米香、粉紅色紙包的糕點，右下角盒子裡還有豬羊糕仔。

This counter is full of traditional Tainan pastries: sesame snacks, puffed rice cakes, and treats wrapped in pink paper.

豬羊糕仔 Pig and goat cakes

盒子裡是小豬、小羊造型的糕仔，背上都點著一抹紅。九豬十六羊是在太陽公生（農曆三月十九）拜拜用的。

In this box are little pig and goat cakes, each with a dab of red. Nine pigs and sixteen goats are offered on the Sun God's birthday.

北郊地磚 North Guild tile

水仙宮市場地上的紅色地磚寫著「北郊」。圖上看起來像一串龍眼和一捲布。北郊由二十多家商號組成，推蘇萬利為代表，專跑福州以北的航線：上海、寧波、天津、煙台、牛莊、大連。從臺灣運出糖、龍眼乾、樟腦，運回綢緞、藥材、棉花和藥膏。

This red tile in the market says North Guild. It seems to show a bunch of longans and a roll of cloth. The North Guild had more than twenty firms, led by Su Wanli. Its ships sailed north of Fuzhou, to Shanghai, Ningbo, Tianjin, Yantai, Niuzhuang and Dalian. They carried sugar, dried longans and camphor out, and brought back silk, medicine, cotton and ointments.

南郊地磚 South Guild tile

藍色地磚寫著「南郊」。圖上看起來像一塊塊方方的貨物、一顆顆圓圓的豆子或米粒，還有一個瓷杯。南郊以金永順為首，專跑福州以南：廈門、漳州、泉州、廣東。從臺灣運出米、豆類、花生、鹿皮，運回藥材、棉布和杉木。

The blue tile says South Guild. It seems to show square blocks of goods, round beans or grains, and a porcelain cup. The South Guild, led by Jin Yongshun, sailed south of Fuzhou, to Xiamen, Zhangzhou, Quanzhou and Guangdong. They carried rice, beans, peanuts and deer hides out, and brought back medicine, cotton cloth and fir timber.

糖郊地磚 Sugar Guild tile

棕色地磚寫著「糖郊」，畫著兩隻手捧著一袋塊狀的糖。糖郊以李元創立的李勝興為首，約有五十多家商號。一開始專做臺灣糖的出口和全臺配送，後來也賣米、豆、麻等農產品。

The brown tile says Sugar Guild. Two hands hold a bag of sugar lumps. The Sugar Guild was led by Li Shengxing, a firm founded by Li Yuan, with about fifty member firms. At first it shipped Taiwan's sugar abroad and across the island, and later it traded rice, beans and hemp too.

水仙宮正面 The temple front

廟門上方的直匾寫著「水仙宮」。門前有兩根用鐵籠圍住的石雕龍柱，大香爐的兩耳是兩條龍。水仙宮在 1985 年公告為第三級古蹟，現在是直轄市定古蹟。

The sign above the door says Shuixian Temple. Two carved stone dragon columns stand in metal cages, and the big incense burner has dragon handles. In 1985, the temple was listed as a historic monument.

正殿 The main hall

上面的金字大匾寫著「水仙尊王」，下面的黑色舊匾寫著「大禹廟」。這裡的主神是治水的大禹，從前的船員和商人都來向祂祈求航海平安。

The gold plaque says Water Immortal King. The dark plaque below says Temple of Yu the Great. The main god here is Yu the Great, or Dayu, who tamed floods. Sailors and merchants prayed to him for safe voyages.

紅色山牆 The red side wall

這是廟的紅色側牆。屋頂邊緣彎成一道弧線，屋脊尾端高高翹起，上面還有一條龍。弧形邊上有一格格花草圖案，還寫著吉祥話「開泰」，祝福平安順利。

This is the temple's red side wall. Its roof edge curves down and up again, and a dragon sits on the roof ridge. Along the edge are flower pictures and the lucky words Kai Tai, a wish for peace and good luck.
